test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On: 2 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Davis Cup is associated with which of the following sports?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Tennis.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Davis Cup is the World Cup of **tennis**.
 
• It is the largest annual international team competition in world sport and was founded in 1900 by Dwight Davis.
 
• The Davis Cup, the** tennis equivalent of the football World Cup, was named after American collegian Dwight Filley Davis**, who came up with the idea to start a challenging tennis match between the USA and Great Britain. 
 
• First played in 1900, it was originally called the International Lawn Tennis Trophy.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Thomas Cup**, trophy signifying world supremacy in the sport of badminton.
 
• In India, **Indian Super League** is related to Indian football.
 
• **Beighton Cup **is related to Hockey.
